audit.whatIsWrong: The chart read Skill / Ornn / Ornn / Skill / Skill / Ornn / Ornn. The mirror (chogath__ornn) already committed to Ornn / Ornn / Ornn / Ornn / Cho'Gath / Ornn / Skill, which is the packet chart, and this page's own whys support it.
audit.why: Cho'Gath must walk into melee to land Rupture, so Level 1 is not neutral. Levels 4-5 are Ornn's: Searing Charge into the pillar knocks up a champion with no dash. Level 6 is his Feast window. At two items his true damage and stacked health make it even at best, not Ornn's.
audit.corrected: Rows 1, 4, 5 and 7 flipped in matched full/content pairs to agree with the mirror; ratings moved with them and the full-layer whys rewritten.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why was boilerplate about the forge and 'Cho'Gath's ultimate'.
audit.why: Feast is 80/70/60 and deals true damage scaling with stacks; it is the reason level 6 belongs to him if Ornn fights below half health.
audit.corrected: phases[4].why now names Feast and the health threshold rule.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page told the player that Feast's true damage defeats resistance stacking, and the cooldown block carried no numbers for Rupture, Feral Scream or Feast.
audit.why: Feast deals true damage and scales off health, so armour and MR are the wrong answer. Rupture is 6s flat at 950 range with a visible ground tell. Feral Scream is an 11s, 300-range cone silence — the reason to spend abilities before closing.
audit.corrected: breakdown.cooldowns, dosFull[0].d and all three dontsFull bodies now carry the numbers and the true-damage rule.

edits.before: Q-poke and AA-trade — your base stats are quietly elite. Identify how Cho'Gath contests the first waves before you commit anything.
edits.after: He must walk into melee range to land Rupture while you are only farming — you are never behind here, so take the free CS.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Rupture's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: Searing Charge into your own pillar knocks up a Cho'Gath with no dash, and Bellows Breath detonates the trade — these levels are yours.

edits.before: Call of the Forge God re-engages a whole fight — and your forge prints item leads. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Cho'Gath's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: This is his Feast spike — a stacked R is true damage on a percent of your health, so it flips any all-in you take below half. Do not fight low.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Cho'Gath carry threat 7/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: He out-tanks you and Feast's true damage ignores your armour — even at best, so anchor fights on your Masterwork lead.

edits.before: - Cho'Gath Rupture: matchup-defining — Telegraphed. Dodge it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Rupture: 6s flat, 950 range, and telegraphed — step off the mark. - Feral Scream: 11s, 300-range cone silence. - Feast: 80s at rank 1, true damage. - Your R: kill windows only.

edits.before: Telegraphed. Dodge it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Rupture is 6s flat and telegraphed — step off it, then step in.

edits.before: That is Cho'Gath's favourite window — refuse it and half his win condition is gone.
edits.after: Rupture is 6s and 950 range with a visible tell — step off the mark, it costs nothing.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Feral Scream silences in a 300-range cone — cast before you close.

edits.before: E-dashing with no terrain in the line — no knockup means you delivered yourself to his combo for free.
edits.after: Feast is true damage on a percent of your health — armour stacking does not answer it, so deny his stacks.

edits.before: Q the pillar behind Cho'Gath, E-dash through it for the knockup when his answer is down, and W-brittle the trade for the proc.
edits.after: Drop the Q pillar behind Cho'Gath, Searing Charge into it for the knockup while Rupture is down, then W to Brittle him.

notes: Chart matched to the mirror rather than to what was on disk, so the two directions agree. Carried over from the mirror and still unfixed on the Cho'Gath side: its 'mid' and 'late' prose says Feral Scream's silence can stop Ornn 'shattering the pillar', which is not a mechanic in Riot's text — Volcanic Rupture leaves a pillar and Searing Charge collides with terrain; nothing shatters anything. This side's prose does not repeat the error, so no edit was needed here, but the Cho'Gath page still needs that second pass. How Brittle is consumed is not in Riot's text and is not asserted anywhere here.
